description: Source code for a firmware image utility, including image headers, checksum calculations, argument parsing, and file writing functions for creating firmware images for different boards.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling argument parsing, image processing, and file output for firmware image creation.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the utility.

methods.name: parse_opt_board
methods.description: Parses and sets the board type based on command line argument.

methods.name: parse_opt_image
methods.description: Parses and sets image files for kernel and filesystem based on command line argument.

methods.name: process_images
methods.description: Prepares and validates kernel and filesystem images based on board specifications.

methods.name: write_out_header
methods.description: Writes the firmware header to the output file based on board type.

methods.name: write_out_images
methods.description: Writes kernel and filesystem images to the output file.

methods.name: image_stat_file
methods.description: Checks and updates image file size and alignment.

methods.name: image_writeout
methods.description: Writes an image to the output file, including padding and checksum.

methods.name: write_out_data
methods.description: Writes data to output file and updates checksum.

methods.name: write_out_padding
methods.description: Writes padding bytes to output file.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Aligns a value to specified boundary.

methods.name: str2u32
methods.description: Converts string argument to uint32_t.

methods.name: str2u16
methods.description: Converts string argument to uint16_t.

methods.name: str2u8
methods.description: Converts string argument to uint8_t.

methods.name: parse_arg
methods.description: Parses colon-separated arguments into an array.

methods.name: required_arg
methods.description: Checks if an argument is provided for an option.

methods.name: is_empty_arg
methods.description: Checks if an argument string is empty.

methods.name: csum_init
methods.description: Initializes checksum state.

methods.name: csum_update
methods.description: Updates checksum state with data.

methods.name: csum_get
methods.description: Retrieves checksum value.

methods.name: csum8_update
methods.description: Updates 8-bit checksum.

methods.name: csum8_get
methods.description: Gets 8-bit checksum.

methods.name: csum16_update
methods.description: Updates 16-bit checksum.

methods.name: csum16_get
methods.description: Gets 16-bit checksum.

methods.name: csum32_update
methods.description: Updates 32-bit checksum.

methods.name: csum32_get
methods.description: Gets 32-bit checksum.
